visualLocks: Exactly one cartoon head with large peach/golden rounded nose, tall white eye shapes and dark pupils, short swept golden-orange hair crest; head floats visibly above the torso with NO NECK.

Compact purple sleeveless pear-shaped torso with a large WHITE RING printed at the abdomen; red hood around its upper rim and small red drawstrings. No shoulders, arms, sleeves, pelvis, trousers or legs.
Exactly TWO white cartoon glove hands with one thumb and three fingers when open; they float independently with clear background gaps to the torso. No wrists, forearms or connecting sticks.
Exactly TWO chunky golden-yellow/orange shoes with white toe/sole trim, detached from the torso and each other. No ankles, shins, thighs, socks or hidden leg connectors.

Ordinary source body arrangement consists of six separated visual islands: head, torso, two hands and two shoes. Hair belongs to the head; red hood belongs to the torso. Keep every physical contour within the portrait.
Source silhouette stays short, elastic and limbless, never a human teenager/adult, a duck beak, Sonic, a Rabbid or a muscular humanoid.
